title: Mahendra Lal Jaini v. State of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Mahendra Lal Jaini v. State of U.P., AIR 1963 SC 1019
content.holding: Affirmed Deep Chand; held that the Doctrine of Eclipse applies only to pre-Constitution laws under Article 13(1), not post-Constitution laws under Article 13(2).
content.relevance: Constitution bench affirmation on scope of eclipse.
